fields.statement: Change set 01M6ZT7 (review/code check fails every run that edits CLI help, settings or the workflow format, because the in-process rhiza check compares docs/reference with the installed binary's rhiza docs): which intent should it serve? It is a regression from #412, the generated reference. / How should run code-check stop judging the branch's docs/reference (and the docs-command rule, which has the same flaw for a newly added, documented command) with the installed binary instead of the branch's build?
